params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Draven}} gains an ''Adoration'' {{tip|stack}} when he catches a {{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}} or kills a {{tip|minion}}, {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|turret}}. He loses ''Adoration'' stacks when he {{tip|death|dies}}.
params.blurb2: When '''Draven''' kills an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he consumes all ''Adoration'' stacks to gain {{g|'''bonus''' gold}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Draven''' catches a ''{{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}}'', kills a non-champion, or destroys a {{tip|turret}}, he gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Adoration''.
params.description2: When '''Draven''' kills an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he consumes all of his ''Adoration'' stacks and gains {{g|25 + (2{{times}}stacks) '''bonus''' gold}}.
params.notes:
* Upon reaching 150 ''Adoration'' stacks, and every 100 stacks thereafter, as well as when he cashes at least 150 stacks in, '''Draven''' automatically sends a chat message notifying all players.
* A chat message will display to all players whenever:
** ''League of Draven'' grants over {{g|300 gold}}.
** ''League of Draven'' gets reduced.
* None of the parts of ''League of Draven'' require actually using a {{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}} for a kill to get ''Adoration'' stacks, as well as to cash ''Adoration'' stacks.
* ''League of Draven'' will trigger upon receiving an assist on an enemy {{tip|execute|executed}} by {{cai|Death from Below|Pyke}}.<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/8je2sr/comment/dyz51mx/ Reav3 confirming Death from Below synergy is intentional]</ref>
* When receiving {{g|gold}} from an ally {{tip|execute|executing}} a minion through {{nie|Shared Riches}} ({{ii|World Atlas}}, {{ii|Runic Compass}}), '''Draven''' is also awarded a [[File:Strike.png|20px]] ''Strike'' stack.{{bug}}
** A ''Strike'' stack lasts up to 10 seconds or until '''Draven''' fails to catch an ''{{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven|axe}}'' or a nearby {{tip|minion}} dies without him killing it. Upon reacing 6 stacks, '''Draven''' consumes the stacks to gain 2 stacks of ''Adoration''.
** Other sources of gaining ''Strike'' stacks were removed in patch [[V25.06]].

blurb.plain: Innate: Draven gains an Adoration stack when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or turret. He loses Adoration stacks when he dies.

blurb2.plain: When Draven kills an enemy champion, he consumes all Adoration stacks to gain bonus gold gold.

description.plain: Innate: When Draven catches a Spinning Axe, kills a non-champion, or destroys a turret, he gains a stack of Adoration.

description2.plain: When Draven kills an enemy champion, he consumes all of his Adoration stacks and gains 25 + (2×stacks) bonus gold gold.

description3.plain: Draven loses 50% of his Adoration stacks upon death.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Draven|Draven's}} next basic attack will throw an axe, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.blurb2: This axe will ricochet off the target high up into the air. If '''Draven''' catches it, he automatically readies another ''Spinning Axe''. '''Draven''' can have two ''Spinning Axes'' at once.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' starts spinning his axe, empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|5.8}} seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.description2: Upon hitting the target, the axe then ricochets off of them to land after roughly 1.4 seconds, with the location being determined by '''Draven's''' {{tt|current movement|See notes}}. If '''Draven''' catches the axe, he gains ''Spinning Axe's'' empowered attack again.
params.description3: '''Draven''' can hold up to two ''Spinning Axes'' at once.
params.notes:
* The landing location is determined by '''Draven's''' [[movement speed]] and direction at the time ''Spinning Axe'' hits the target. If '''Draven''' is actually moving, it will bounce directly into his path. Otherwise, it will bounce back towards his current location, either landing directly onto him or to his sides.
* ''Spinning Axe'' will place a visual cue on the ground where it will land. This visual cue is visible to both teams, although '''Draven''' himself will see a more prominent marker.
* Axes take roughly 1.35-1.40s to go from target to landing point. This is not affected by attack speed, movement speed or level.
* Recasting ''Spinning Axe'' will refresh the {{tip|buff}} and add another axe if possible.
** There is no limit to how many axes can be juggled at once, just the limit of 2 of them at a time in '''Draven's''' hands.
* '''Draven''' used to be able to catch (steal) an enemy '''Draven''''s axes. This event also prompted a few unique voice lines.  
* ''Spinning Axes'' may optically bypass {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} but they will be destroyed upon collision. {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} will not prevent the axe from bouncing off when {{ci|Braum}} is the target.
* {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} will not prevent the axe from bouncing off when {{ci|Braum}} is not the target.
* The axe will still bounce against parrying effects.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} does not interact with the effects of the axes.
* If a ''Spinning Axe'' is readied during a basic attack wind-up, the effects will be applied to the fired attack.
* ''Spinning Axe'' attacks deal their total increased damage in a single instance of {{tip|basic damage}}.
* ''Spinning Axe'' may fail to properly bounce back if it hits {{ci|Zaahen}} during or shortly after {{ais|Cultivation of War|Zaahen}} revive.{{bug}}
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
** The duration will refresh on-attack against them.
* ''Spinning Axe'' has an indicator that appears on the ground for Draven to stand on. Some skins have a unique indicator.
